msg: there are two pairs of gnomes, one pair is brown and red, the other pair are green and purple. you have 1.5 seconds to select a gnome and 1.5 seconds to press spacebar to collect the mushrooms. the highest number of mushrooms you can collect is 9. to start with test to see which side offers the higher amount this can vary, once decidedstick with it for a while,after some time the amount starts reducing, when itgets to +4 mushrooms now is the time to switch to the other coloured gnome.
